title: A tree, flattened
description:
Turn a tree of game objects into the rows a tree view draws, honouring open and closed nodes.

```
v world
  v players
      ada
      bob
  > enemies (3 hidden)
rows: 5
```
hints: Add the node's row, then recurse into children only when it is open (lesson 14.04).
Counting hidden rows is a second small recursive function.
requirements: Nodes have a name, an open flag and children.
Produce rows with depth; closed nodes show how many descendants are hidden.
Clicking a row toggles that node and the rows are rebuilt.
stretch: Keep only the rows on screen (a clipper) when there are thousands.
